description: HesabYar Phase 3 (per design-eng.md §17, §5, §18): modern Persian admin dashboard. Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript strict + Tailwind v4 + pnpm, RTL-first Persian UI in apps/admin/, talking to the HesabYar FastAPI backend ONLY through Next.js BFF routes (no direct browser-to-Tryton, no browser-held credentials — spec §19 rule 1, §4 line 252). Builds on branch ralph/phase-2 (29 REST endpoints under /api/v1, API-key auth, 730 Python tests green). Spec: ~/workspace/user/files/design-eng_0_zaup.md (§5 frontend/design system, §11.3 dashboard widgets, §16.5 frontend tests, §18 nav modules). Exit criteria: daily accounting operations work from the Persian-first panel without opening Sao.

acceptanceCriteria: pnpm installed in the environment (corepack enable, fallback npm i -g pnpm) and apps/admin/ scaffolded: Next.js 16.x App Router (pinned patch), React 19.x, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS v4, pnpm-lock.yaml committed; `pnpm -C apps/admin build` passes

Root document lang="fa" dir="rtl"; Vazirmatn (or another licensed Persian font) with Persian OpenType shaping; CSS logical properties only (no hard-coded left/right); single shared theme-token layer (tokens.css), light theme default per §5.4

Unified UI facade at apps/admin/components/ui/ per §5.3 (button, input, select, dialog, drawer, data-table, date-picker, jalali-date-picker, amount-input, money-display, status-badge, command-menu, toast, skeleton) — feature pages import ONLY from the facade, never from copied registry files directly

Components sourced from VibeFarsi (vibefarsi.ir, via its CLI: npx vibefarsi init / add — ready-made components, not hand-rolled lookalikes) for Persian-specific patterns (Jalali dates, Persian digits, Toman display, business forms) and FarsiUI (farsiui.ir) for accessible primitives (dialogs, drawers, inputs, navigation, tables) per §5.2; never two implementations of the same primitive on one page; MIT license/attribution files preserved when copying substantial code

Auth via BFF: (auth)/login page takes an operator API key (hya_live_...); a Next.js route handler validates it against the FastAPI backend and issues an httpOnly session cookie; the key is kept server-side only and the browser never holds it after login; all data calls go through BFF routes that attach the key; unauthenticated dashboard routes redirect to /login

Typed API client (lib/api-client.ts) over the BFF for all 29 Phase 1+2 endpoints; lib/format-money.ts (integer IRR, Toman display-only and explicitly labelled, Persian digits for presentation only, ASCII normalization for validation/storage) and lib/jalali.ts (deterministic Jalali↔Gregorian mapping, never inferred from ambiguous strings) per §5.5

Test tooling in place: unit/component tests (vitest + testing-library) and browser e2e (Playwright or equivalent, runnable against the real backend); `pnpm -C apps/admin test` and `pnpm -C apps/admin exec tsc --noEmit` pass; a dev API key is minted via ApiKeyService (as the Phase 1 e2e fixtures do) and documented for local dev — dev-only, never committed
Python suite still green (730 passed) — no backend regressions
userStories.description: As the platform I want the Next.js shell, Persian theme, UI facade and BFF auth in place, so every dashboard feature builds on one tested foundation.

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard home at (dashboard)/page.tsx with §11.3 widgets built ONLY from live API data: unposted journal drafts (journal-drafts list), receivables/payables from the invoices list (state + totals + party), recent invoices/payments; every tile states its period, company and unit and links to the underlying filtered page; widgets with no API source yet (cash position, trial-balance-based figures, tax/Moadian status) are honest coming-soon tiles — no fake data, no KPI without a source

Collapsible RTL sidebar + compact top bar + breadcrumbs per §5.4 with the 13 §18 navigation modules; modules whose pages land in later phases (compliance, integrations, AI/MCP, API management, users, settings detail) are visible but disabled with a coming-soon state — module boundaries stay intact, no duplicate CRM module, no Tryton ERP navigation

Chart of accounts page (accounting/accounts): hierarchical list/tree from GET /api/v1/accounting/accounts (code, name, type), search by code/name, type filter, detail panel per account; LTR isolation for account codes; empty/loading/error states
Fiscal years/periods view from the US-203 endpoints (open/closed state, company-scoped) and setup-status display, reachable from the accounting section
Filters, sorting and pagination use normalized values, never localized display strings (§5.5 rule 10); keyboard navigable; verified live in the browser against the real backend + Tryton

acceptanceCriteria: Journal list page from GET /api/v1/accounting/journal-drafts: state filter (draft/posted), period filter, search; each row shows date (Jalali display, Gregorian stored), description, totals (integer IRR, Toman display where labelled), state badge; detail panel with lines

Journal draft editor: create + edit drafts (POST/PATCH) with a debit/credit line grid, account picker (from the accounts endpoint), Jalali date entry, per-line one-sided amounts; the editor blocks unbalanced saves (debit total must equal credit total, > 0) and shows the running balance live; Idempotency-Key sent on create/post/reverse

Validate → post → reverse actions wired to the real endpoints with confirm dialogs, success/error toasts and audit-visible results; a posted journal has NO edit/delete path in the UI (§19 rule 8); reversal asks for confirmation and links to the reversal
All mutations go through the BFF with the session key; permission-denied (403) and validation (422) errors from the API surface as readable Persian messages, never raw JSON
Verified live in the browser against real Tryton: create a draft → validate → post → reverse end-to-end from the UI, with the posted move visible in Tryton
userStories.description: As an accountant I want to list, edit, validate, post and reverse journals from the panel, so daily bookkeeping never needs Sao.

acceptanceCriteria: Invoices page from GET /api/v1/invoices: list with state filter (draft/validated/posted/paid/cancelled), party search, totals in integer IRR; detail panel with lines, party name, untaxed/tax/total; invoice draft creation form (POST /invoices/drafts) + validate action (POST /invoices/{id}/validate); no invoice finalize/payment actions in the UI (not exposed by the API yet — do not fake them)
Payments page from GET /api/v1/payments: list + detail panel (party, amount, state, method where the API provides it); read-only — payment create/approve is not exposed by the API yet

Bank statements page from GET /api/v1/bank/statements: list + detail + import-status summary; reconcile button present but honestly disabled with a coming-soon note (the API returns a typed 501 — the UI must not pretend it works)
Filters, export of the visible list (CSV, normalized values) and detail panels per §17; empty/loading/error/permission-denied states on every page
Verified live in the browser against the real backend + Tryton with the test company's data

acceptanceCriteria: Reports section with views computable from the live API only: posted-move ledger (journal list filtered to posted, with lines and running totals), invoice summaries by state/party, payment summaries; every figure states its period, company and unit and links to its source rows

Trial balance, balance sheet, P&L and cash flow are shown as honest coming-soon (they need a backend report endpoint — get_report was deferred in Phase 2; the UI must NOT compute them client-side from paginated lists and must NOT show fabricated figures); the deferral is recorded in progress.txt with its reason
CSV export on lists and report views (normalized values, §5.5 rule 10); print-friendly report view

Responsive + accessibility pass over the whole dashboard: layouts verified at 390px/320px (viewing, approvals, light operations) and desktop (full journal editing); keyboard navigation and dialog focus traps; reduced-motion respected; contrast AA on text; no horizontal overflow at any checked width

Full Phase 3 e2e verification in a live browser against the real backend + Tryton: login → dashboard → accounts → journal create/validate/post/reverse → invoices → payments → statements → reports → logout; every page reachable, no console errors, no dead buttons; `pnpm -C apps/admin build`, typecheck, lint and all frontend tests pass; Python suite still green (730 passed)
